digest.component_or_area: explain guide resolution in the plan-review registry
propositions: explain plan/review/<criterion-id> read guide markdown from the consuming project's repo_root/docs/, which is absent when rebar is installed against another project, causing missing-file failures.
The author and code-review guides are moved into the import package under src/rebar/_guides and read via importlib.resources, matching the pattern already used for criteria_routing.json.
AUTHOR_GUIDES changes from path-component tuples to bare filename strings and explain_guide drops its repo_root_path parameter, resolving guides independent of repo root.

explain_criterion renders sections directly from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body instead of reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md, while overlay project criteria still resolve via load_criteria.
docs/ guide files remain as thin pointer files so existing links do not break.
Guides must be accessible from CLI, MCP, and Python library surfaces from any installation, verified with REBAR_ROOT set to a directory lacking docs/.
